main.description: A segment's leaderboard: each athlete's fastest ranked effort that the viewer may see, fastest first. Only active segments have one; any other status has no entries. An effort is ranked unless its athlete hides from leaderboards, its activity is excluded, or its average speed is above its sport group's cap. E-bike efforts are ranked only on a ride segment's e-bike board.

period.description: By the effort's local date, against the AppView's current calendar year or month in UTC.

scope.description: following: only the viewer and the athletes they effectively follow. Needs a signed-in viewer.

eBike.description: The e-bike board instead of the standard one.

ageGroup.description: Only athletes in this age group (actor.leaderboardBrackets). Absent means every age, and athletes without brackets.

weightClass.description: Only athletes in this weight class, in kilograms (actor.leaderboardBrackets).

viewer.description: The signed-in viewer's own entry, whichever page this is; absent when they aren't on the board.

errors.name: NotFound
errors.description: The segment isn't indexed, or isn't served (as for getSegment).

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: An unknown period, scope, age group, weight class or gender, or the following scope without a signed-in viewer.
